verdict.rationale: Reader fetches a page with a single call (`https://r.jina.ai/<url>`, with browser or curl engines), and the `x-respond-with` header selects the output format. However, the evidence only names Markdown/frontmatter outputs and markets the product as producing clean, LLM-ready text rather than raw HTML. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an HTML/raw-HTML value for `x-respond-with`, an example of returning unmodified page HTML, independent or hands-on confirmation.
